pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":"Lead organizers (Sanjay, Marcus) for consults and sessions at the client's home; studio organizers (Hana, Rafael) at the studio","licenses":"No person license unless the state's form asks. pluginText.pf.rules: {"agreement":"A written agreement for project work, signed by the client and the business before any deposit: the rooms, the sessions and hours, the project price and how it is paid, who decides what stays, and the change-order rule","decides":"Nothing is thrown away, donated or shredded without the owner of the things saying yes at that moment; papers that may be legal, tax or medical are set aside for the owner, never discarded","never_handled":"Valuables, cash, medicines, IDs and firearms are set aside by the owner; the organizer never handles them","agreement_parts":"Any parts the state's form lists, like a registration number or the cancel notice for an agreement that began at the home","cancel_window":"Where the rules give a cancel window for a sale made at the home, nothing starts until it ends","unsafe_homes":"A home with a blocked exit, pests, mold or waste is not an organizing job until it is cleaned or cleared by a licensed service or the family","show":"A registration number on the listing, the plan and the agreement, where the state's rules require it","warranty":"No guarantee of results. A free fix visit for a label or bin put in the wrong place within 14 days (the owner's setting)","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"family_booker":"A relative books for an older parent: the parent is the person served and decides what stays; the relative cannot decide for them unless papers on file say so","upset_owner":"The owner gets upset or changes their mind: the session pauses or moves, with no fee for the business's side","found_item":"Cash, medicines, IDs, firearms or something that looks unsafe is set aside for the owner and never handled or described in a text","organizer_cannot_come":"The business moves the session or offers another organizer, with no fee","customer_not_ready":"Paths or things are not set aside as agreed: the session can't start; whose side it is decides the fee","walk_through_dispute":"Goes to Sam; the last bill waits","renter":"A renter's fixed shelves or hooks need the landlord's OK","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
